message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/gpac; grep -rn "GF_M4ASampleRates" src/ | head -30` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: The fix is in `src/filters/reframe_latm.c`. The vulnerability is a heap-buffer-overflow READ 4 caused by `GF_M4ASampleRates[ctx->acfg.base_sr_index]` being accessed with an out-of-bounds index. Let me look at the relevant code.
